questions.prompt: What is the capital city of Uzbekistan?

hints.nudge: A capital city is where a country’s government meets. The other three are capital cities too, of other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Uzbekistan article.

questions.proof: Its capital and largest city is Tashkent.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries shares a border with Uzbekistan?

hints.nudge: Two countries are neighbours when you can walk from one into the other. Picture Uzbekistan on the globe and look at what it touches.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Uzbekistan article.

questions.proof: The neighbouring countries are Afghanistan, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan and Turkmenistan.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “There are about 37,5 million people living in Uzbekistan, in _____.”

hints.nudge: It is a year in the twenty-first century.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Uzbekistan article.

questions.proof: There are about 37,5 million people living in Uzbekistan, in 2023.
